delivered.body: Confidential Settlement Agreement RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims. 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD [Settlement Amount] by wire transfer to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff, within ten (10) business days after the Effective Date. The parties shall cooperate in good faith to complete the payment instructions and confirm the Settlement Amount in the final execution version. 2. RELEASE. Upon payment, Plaintiff releases all claims against Defendant. 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential. 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability.
